name: F-16C with 4 × AIM-120 (AIM-120C-DCS), airframe fitted to DCS
description: F-16C-DCS with the F-16C-DCSFIT airframe (thrust, drag, lift limit and g lag fitted to the player's F-16C in DCS) and the launch delay of the stick pilot's cockpit work. The platform to train for dcs_live.py --stick.

sources.WPN_COUNT: standard BVR loadout in this project
sources.RCS_M2: commonly cited open-source frontal estimate (≈ 1.2 m²)
sources.SPEED_CMDS: the action set existing checkpoints were trained with; 460 m/s added in SIM_REV 14 (Mach 1.5 at 9 km, the DCS AI's dash in combat)
sources.CLIMB_FPA_LO: holds speed on a 3 km climb (measured)
sources.LAUNCH_DELAY_MIN: measured 2026-10-14 from timed bugs and launches (and any live runs) (fire_delay_20261014_141533.json): the 10th and 90th percentiles, to 0.5 s
sources.LAUNCH_DELAY_MAX: measured 2026-10-14 from timed bugs and launches (and any live runs) (fire_delay_20261014_141533.json): the 10th and 90th percentiles, to 0.5 s
